RESUME

UDAYAKUMAR PANNEERSELVAM

No: 1&2, Flat No: E2, Ground Floor, RM Manikandan Flats,

12th Street Secretariat Colony, Lakshmipuram, Chennai – 600 099.

Mobile: +91 75026 09388

Email : bavi.mzcet@gmail.com

Career Objective:

Work in a challenging role utilizing my technical skills along with my professional experience to effectively contribute to the growth of the organization.

Professional Experience:

Company:		Accenture Solutions Private Limited

Job title:		Business Analyst

Project Names:	Standard Chartered Bank, Nationwide Building Society and Eradah Capital

Duration:		February 2021 to June 2026

Roles & Responsibilities:

Working closely with the Business PO to understand the business requirements which pertain to International Payments.

Communicating with stakeholders and other departments to provide solutions for the product requirements, to solve the existing issues in BAU and to reduce the manual work.

Experienced in handling MX message migration in core Transaction Processing system – ISO 20022.

Experienced with Cross border SWIFT payments – Pacs.008, Pacs.009, Pacs.009COV, MT103, MT202, MT202COV in India Telegraphic Transfer (TT).

Responsible for creating user stories in Jira and Azure DevOps tools and presenting to the squad.

Closely working with scrum by following the Agile methodology, attending daily scrum call to discuss the updates towards the requirement activity and resolve if any issues.

Having knowledge in API interfaces between core processing system and other associated applications.

Experienced at analyzing the current business model for performing Gap analysis and generating ‘As – Is’ and ‘To – Be’ process flows.



Having knowledge on Payments, Treasury and Reconciliation tool’s UAT testing.

Having knowledge on Payments Screening application and the Fircosoft format.

Company:		BNP Paribas Global Securities Operations Private Limited

Job title:		Assistant Manager

Process Name:	Middle Office Derivatives Operation (Trade Booking)

Duration:		April 2020 to October 2020

Roles & Responsibilities:

Monitoring the Derivatives Trade Booking team daily to ensure the trade instructions received from the client are booked on the system in a timely manner without any errors.

Making sure the checklist activities are done within the deadline.

Taking complete ownership of the team, provide road maps to the team towards driving the goals of the organization.

Decision making on the work allocation and cross training plan for the team.

Review quality errors and provide feedback to the team to maintain accuracy in the process.

Maintaining a good rapport with onshore and internal department to run the process smoothly.

Company:		BNY Mellon International Operations (India) Private Limited

Job title:		Senior Analyst

Process Name:	Transfer Agency 

Duration:		November 2016 to April 2020

Roles & Responsibilities:

Reconciliation of Bank accounts (Client money, Operating and Distribution account) and control accounts using TLM as a reconciliation tool to maintain accurate records for each client.

Reviewing the activities performed by the Operations executive to ensure the outstanding breaks on the reconciliation are valid and to investigate in clearing the breaks.

Handling the queries from onshore and internal department in a timely manner.

Preparing the MIS report to submit to onshore monthly.

Providing process improvement ideas (auto match rules and automation of reports) to reduce the manual work on the process.



Company:		State Street HCL Services

Job title:		Specialist

Process Name:	Alternative Investment Services (Hedge Funds)

Duration:		September 2014 to September 2016

Roles & Responsibilities:

Reconciliation of daily cash and position between multiple prime brokers and maintaining accounting records for multiple currencies.

Gathering of various broker reports from sources like broker websites and client mails.

Booking all accruals, interest, charges and payments on a daily/monthly basis.

Protection of Customers Confidential data and preventing it from outsiders.

To follow up with the operations team for any trade-related breaks and clear them from Reconciliation tool.

Successfully worked on reduction of manual work in the account setup of the    fund.

Worked closely with team members to understand their knowledge and provide training to improve their skill set.

Company:		RBS Business Services Private Limited

Job title:		Process Associate

Process Name:	International Payments

Duration:		November 2011 to May 2014

Operational Roles and Responsibilities: 

Performing the prechecks for the instructions received through various modes.

Processing and verifying the Domestic and International transfers including all incoming, outgoing, and internal payments, also handling client issues raised by the internal team.

Creating and verifying the telex messages (MT192, MT195, MT196 and MT199).

Processing and verifying Amendments, Cancellations, Return of funds and MT 191 claims.

Input the required payment details into Non STP payments which fall in the Repair queue due to invalid formatting and insufficient details.

Communicating with banks through swift messages such as MT199, MT999 and email.

Contacting respective banks through SWIFT and making appropriate escalation for a speedy resolution.



Educational Summary:

M.B.A (Finance & Marketing)

G.R.Damodaran Academy of Management, 2009 - 2011

Secured 74%, 1st Class

B.E (Electronics and Communication Engineering)

	Anjalai Ammal Mahalingam Engineering College, 2005 - 2009

Secured 77%, 1st Class with Distinction

HSC (Higher Secondary Education)

Mount Zion Matriculation Higher Secondary School, 2003 - 2005

Secured 93.25%, 1st Class with Distinction 

SSLC (Secondary School Leaving Certificate)

Mount Zion Matriculation Higher Secondary School, 2002 - 2003

Secured 83.81%, 1st Class with Distinction

Credits/Achievements:

Got certified in CIPSP (Certified International Payment Systems Professional) training conducted by MVLCO.

Got client appreciation from Standard Chartered for working on CBPR+ mapping, IN Gift City payment’s migration and IN TT payment’s migration to new Transaction Processing system.

Got the Bravo award two times in BNY Mellon for providing auto match rules in TLM and handling the Pune out successfully without the Team leader.

Got the BEST SENIOR ANALYST AWARD in State Street HCL Services for achieving 100% error free process for the year 2015.

Got the BEST LEADER award in an outbound training conducted by Master.

Stroke HR solutions India private Limited.

Personal Details:

Date of birth:			02.09.1988

Age:				37

Gender:			Male

Marital status:			Married

Nationality:			Indian

Passport Number:		B9239600

Languages known:		English & Tamil

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
Professional Experience:
Company:		Accenture Solutions Private Limited
Job title:		Business Analyst
Project Names:	Standard Chartered Bank, Nationwide Building Society and Eradah Capital
Duration:		February 2021 to June 2026
Roles & Responsibilities:
Working closely with the Business PO to understand the business requirements which pertain to International Payments.
Communicating with stakeholders and other departments to provide solutions for the product requirements, to solve the existing issues in BAU and to reduce the manual work.
Experienced in handling MX message migration in core Transaction Processing system – ISO 20022.
Experienced with Cross border SWIFT payments – Pacs.008, Pacs.009, Pacs.009COV, MT103, MT202, MT202COV in India Telegraphic Transfer (TT).
Responsible for creating user stories in Jira and Azure DevOps tools and presenting to the squad.
Closely working with scrum by following the Agile methodology, attending daily scrum call to discuss the updates towards the requirement activity and resolve if any issues.
Having knowledge in API interfaces between core processing system and other associated applications.
Experienced at analyzing the current business model for performing Gap analysis and generating ‘As – Is’ and ‘To – Be’ process flows.
Having knowledge on Payments, Treasury and Reconciliation tool’s UAT testing.
Having knowledge on Payments Screening application and the Fircosoft format.
Company:		BNP Paribas Global Securities Operations Private Limited
Job title:		Assistant Manager
Process Name:	Middle Office Derivatives Operation (Trade Booking)
Duration:		April 2020 to October 2020
Roles & Responsibilities:
Monitoring the Derivatives Trade Booking team daily to ensure the trade instructions received from the client are booked on the system in a timely manner without any errors.
Making sure the checklist activities are done within the deadline.
Taking complete ownership of the team, provide road maps to the team towards driving the goals of the organization.
Decision making on the work allocation and cross training plan for the team.
Review quality errors and provide feedback to the team to maintain accuracy in the process.
Maintaining a good rapport with onshore and internal department to run the process smoothly.
Company:		BNY Mellon International Operations (India) Private Limited
Job title:		Senior Analyst
Process Name:	Transfer Agency 
Duration:		November 2016 to April 2020
Roles & Responsibilities:
Reconciliation of Bank accounts (Client money, Operating and Distribution account) and control accounts using TLM as a reconciliation tool to maintain accurate records for each client.
Reviewing the activities performed by the Operations executive to ensure the outstanding breaks on the reconciliation are valid and to investigate in clearing the breaks.
Handling the queries from onshore and internal department in a timely manner.
Preparing the MIS report to submit to onshore monthly.
Providing process improvement ideas (auto match rules and automation of reports) to reduce the manual work on the process.
Company:		State Street HCL Services
Job title:		Specialist
Process Name:	Alternative Investment Services (Hedge Funds)
Duration:		September 2014 to September 2016
Roles & Responsibilities:
Reconciliation of daily cash and position between multiple prime brokers and maintaining accounting records for multiple currencies.
Gathering of various broker reports from sources like broker websites and client mails.
Booking all accruals, interest, charges and payments on a daily/monthly basis.
Protection of Customers Confidential data and preventing it from outsiders.
To follow up with the operations team for any trade-related breaks and clear them from Reconciliation tool.
Successfully worked on reduction of manual work in the account setup of the    fund.
Worked closely with team members to understand their knowledge and provide training to improve their skill set.
Company:		RBS Business Services Private Limited
Job title:		Process Associate
Process Name:	International Payments
Duration:		November 2011 to May 2014
Operational Roles and Responsibilities: 
Performing the prechecks for the instructions received through various modes.
Processing and verifying the Domestic and International transfers including all incoming, outgoing, and internal payments, also handling client issues raised by the internal team.
Creating and verifying the telex messages (MT192, MT195, MT196 and MT199).
Processing and verifying Amendments, Cancellations, Return of funds and MT 191 claims.
Input the required payment details into Non STP payments which fall in the Repair queue due to invalid formatting and insufficient details.
Communicating with banks through swift messages such as MT199, MT999 and email.
Contacting respective banks through SWIFT and making appropriate escalation for a speedy resolution.
